List out the account numbers of female clients who are oldest and has lowest average salary, calculate the gap between this lowest average salary with the highest average salary?

function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql":"WITH
oldest_birth AS (SELECT MIN(birth_date) AS min_birth FROM client WHERE gender='F'),
lowest_a11 AS (SELECT MIN(a11) AS min_a11, MAX(a11) AS max_a11 FROM district),
filtered_clients AS (
  SELECT c.client_id
  FROM client c
  CROSS JOIN oldest_birth ob
  CROSS JOIN lowest_a11 la
  WHERE c.gender='F'
    AND c.birth_date = ob.min_birth
    AND c.district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM district d WHERE d.a11 = la.min_a11)
)
SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id AS account_number,
       (la.max_a11 - la.min_a11) AS salary_gap
FROM filtered_clients fc
JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = fc.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = d.account_id
CROSS JOIN lowest_a11 la;
"}
